item.coloph: rdo rje 'phag mos mngon sum du byin gyis brlabs pa'i paN+Di ta chen po 'jigs med 'byung gnas sbas pa'i zhal snga nas mdzad pa rdzogs pa'i rnal 'byor gyi phreng ba zhes bya ba rdzogs so/ /'di'i gzhung tshad ni stong nyis brgya bzhus so/ /rgya gar gyi paN+Di ta chen po thams cad mkhyen pa'i dpal bzang pos 'gyur rnying pa la brten nas smon 'gre'i gtsug lag khang du sgra rang sgyur mdzad pa'o/ /paN+Di ta de nyid kyis lan gnyis su zhus shing gtugs so/ slad kyi rgya gar gyi paN+Di ta chen po mkhas btsun mchog gi grub pa rnyes pa/ bla ma rje btsun chen po rat+na rak+Shi ta'i zhabs dang / bla ma rje btsun paN+Di ta chen po re wan+d+ra'i zhal snga nas/ chag lo tsA ba shAkya'i dge slong dpal gyi mtha' can gyis zhus shing dag par bsgyur te gtan la phab pa'o
